 Coca-Cola HBC raises 2026 revenue growth forecast on strong demand
 Agencies Synopsis
 Coca-Cola HBC has upgraded its annual organic revenue growth outlook, driven by successful pricing strategies and heightened consumer demand. In the third quarter, the company achieved a notable 9% organic revenue growth, surpassing the anticipated 8%. This surge was propelled by effective promotional initiatives tied to the FIFA World Cup and increased summer demand.
 By Anupam Nagar , ETMarkets.com Nov 04, 2026, 03:36:00 PM IST Follow us Coca-Cola HBC on Wednesday raised its annual organic revenue growth forecast, supported by pricing actions and robust demand for sparkling drinks and sugar-free beverages across its key markets, Reuters reported.
 ADVERTISEMENT The Switzerland-based bottler, which distributes Coca-Cola products across Central and Eastern Europe and Africa, has sustained growth despite rising energy, fuel and commodity costs following the Iran war.
The company now expects organic revenue growth in fiscal 2026 to be slightly above its previous forecast range of 6% to 7%. It had earlier anticipated growth at the upper end of that range, Reuters reported. 
Coca-Cola HBC has adjusted product prices and packaging to cater to changing consumer preferences as households become increasingly value-conscious amid rising inflation and geopolitical uncertainty. 
Read more: Nikkei slides to 3-month low as AI stocks tumble on US election jitters 
The company reported third-quarter organic revenue growth of 9%, beating the analyst consensus of 8% compiled by the company. Strong demand during the summer season and promotional campaigns linked to Coca-Cola's partnership with the FIFA World Cup in June and July supported growth, Reuters reported.
 ADVERTISEMENT 
The campaigns included special-edition Coca-Cola and Powerade packaging.
